headline: Space Energy Audit, from entry to detail
overview: Evaluate each room for energy, cleanliness, organization, comfort, and lighting. Understand how your physical spaces affect your mental and emotional state, and identify targeted improvements.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Space Energy Audit — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the room evaluation interface with dimensions: energy, cleanliness, organization, comfort, and lighting.
steps.screenshotAlt: Space Energy Audit landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Evaluate rooms across 5 energy dimensions: energy, cleanliness, organization, comfort, and lighting
Generate a comprehensive space energy report for your entire home
Identify which rooms drain vs. restore your energy
Receive targeted recommendations for each room's highest-impact improvements
tips: Audit a room immediately after spending time in it — your intuitive reaction captures the energy better than a detached analysis.
Focus first on the rooms where you spend the most time; even small improvements to your bedroom or workspace can have outsized impact.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
